QuestInfo.name: In Search of an Antidote
QuestInfo.0: Help #p2152004# make an antidote for #p2151005#'s poison.
QuestInfo.1: You need a Feather Plant from Victoria Island to make the antidote. Go to #m103000000# and ask #p1052001# for help.
QuestInfo.2: #p1052001# says #m103000000# don't have that many Feather Plants either. He can get about half of what you need, but that's it.
